title: Farrukh Abdullah, Researcher and Writer | BettaFish.website
description: Meet Farrukh Abdullah, the researcher and writer responsible for BettaFish.website guides and their source-led content structure.
intro: Farrukh Abdullah researches, structures and writes the educational guides published by BettaFish.website.

sections.heading: Role at BettaFish.website
paragraphs: Farrukh turns aquarium-care questions, topic research and named sources into structured guides designed to help readers make safer husbandry decisions.

He is responsible for research organization, first drafts, source records, page architecture and corrections. Review and editing are handled separately so the same person does not silently approve his own work.

sections.heading: Scope and limits
paragraphs: Farrukh is not presented as an aquatic veterinarian. BettaFish.website distinguishes routine husbandry information from health guidance and directs readers to an aquatic veterinarian when individualized assessment is needed.
His professional work in semantic SEO and content systems informs how the site organizes entities, questions and sources; it is not used as a substitute for animal-health credentials.

sections.heading: Professional profile
sections.text: Farrukh's broader work in semantic SEO, GEO and content architecture is documented on his professional website.
